page.title: Best French Presses from Top Stores
page.description: Compare the best french presses from top stores in one place.
guide: French presses listed here range from $20 to $140. Common materials are double-walled stainless steel, glass, and ceramic, with many offering a polished or brushed finish.

When picking a press, consider capacity, 8-cup models are typical for home use-and whether the wall is insulated to keep coffee hot longer. A sturdy metal filter and a comfortable plunger are also important.
Cleaning is easier with removable filters and dishwasher-safe parts. If you prefer a lighter press, glass models are lighter but can be more fragile than steel.

merchantProducts.title: Bodum Tribute Double Wall French Press
merchantProducts.description:
The Bodum Tribute Double Wall French Press perfects our favorite brewing method with excellent heat retention and a premium stainless design that brings a little personality to the breakfast table. The TRIBUTE PRESSO is based on Bodum's iconic french press brewing system, which delivers a full-flavored extraction, while its unique double-wall construction ensures your coffee stays hotter for longer. Beloved by coffee connoisseurs for its simplicity of brewing and purity of taste, the French press brewing system transforms hot water and coarsely ground beans into that most flavorsome of drinks in just four short minutes. All without using wasteful paper filters, plastic capsules and the other trappings of modern coffee brewing. Combining classic French press taste with a bold, modern style, the TRIBUTE PRESSO coffee maker allows you to brew and entertain in style. It also makes a great gift for the environmentally conscious coffee lover in your life.

Features of the Bodum Tribute Double Wall French Press include:

  • French press functionality with a durable stainless steel double wall construction for greater heat retention
  • 34 oz. capacity brews about 8 European cups (4 oz)/ 4 US cups (8 oz)
  • Silicone and mesh plunger prevents scratching, offers a more complete filtration, and reduces sediment
  • Black plastic handle that’s cool to touch and comfortable to use
  • Environmentally friendly method of brewing – no paper filters or plastic capsules required
  • Easy to use and easy to clean
